description: The Designer CG Designer bundles, in its own window, may read which keyboard language the window types in (TEXT-DIGITS-01); (D-162) answer the window's close: hold it while it can ask about unsaved changes (close_guard), say it has the ask (close_request_seen) and close the window once answered (close_window_now); and (B-356) choose one bounded UTF-8 text source and re-read only that session-authorized path. Nothing else.
